scope: Three grayscale isolated PHG-style candidates from secondary community screenshot references; City Hunter97 and Kawaii Phoenix remain variants.

entries.label: Detox
entries.prompt:
Create ONE isolated biomask using the exact same visible design, shape proportions and near-front camera as the attached reference. The256x257 RGB screenshot of an unofficial community game-port HUD icon is the only authority for this edit. It is a secondary community reference, not a certified original franchise capture. Preserve the visible whole mask contour, width-to-height proportion, yaw/pitch/roll, panel layout, dark optics/apertures, surface reliefs and recognizable visible fine marks. Do not redesign it from a familiar franchise name.

The requested change is ONLY to isolate the hard mask and stage its visible surfaces as a coherent high-quality Predator:Hunting Grounds-style game-prop render. REMOVE the white/grey external dreadlocks and all pale hanging hair strands, hair bands, wearer/head/neck/body and the black reference background. These external strands are not mask appendages. Keep the actual mask shell and its clearly visible attached hardware. Do not add hair, neck, wearer, stand, floor, cables behind the shell, invented back, hidden profile geometry, horns, holes, vents, tubes, teeth, glyphs, letters or extra ornaments. Do not rebuild missing details from canon or imagination.

Maintain the source's grayscale without adding any colored albedo, eye glow or warm gold. Original albedo and physical materials are unknown; this is a restrained grayscale material interpretation. Use physically coherent grey metallic and dark grey surfaces, roughness variations, a soft neutral key light from upper left/front, soft opposite frontal fill, legible dark recesses and contained fine surface grain. Preserve visible wear rather than adding damage, avoid all-over chrome, avoid crushed black outlines, avoid powdery noise. Retain the source's visible fine-line arrangements without adding runes or changing their placement; no claim of character-perfect engraving from a256px source.

ONE single mask, no sheet, no duplicate, no collage, no text or labels. True transparent alpha background, no baked black, no checkerboard. Square canvas, request1254x1254 if supported. Center the complete mask at approximately78–82 percent of the largest canvas dimension, with8–12 percent transparent margins and no cropped edges. Preserve source shape proportions; do not flatten, stretch, rotate to another angle or create a new side view.

VISIBLE DESIGN LOCKS — Detox: the shell has a broad curved horseshoe-shaped top crown with a deep central U-shaped notch, layered outer side rims and a tapering brow down the center. The two very large dark round goggle-like eye openings have grey circular rims. Below them is a small centered rounded nose-like mechanical piece with vertical slots, and the visible lower face has a tightly clustered breathing/filter arrangement with small circular openings and the same outward-curving short tube/mouth shapes. Preserve the count, positions and curved paths seen in the reference; do not replace these with a generic Predator muzzle. The curved crown and all these lower-face hard parts belong to the mask; the long pale strands behind and below the sides do not. Do not add skull teeth, long tusks or a respirator hose not visible in the screenshot.

REFERENCE LIMITATIONS TO RESPECT: Secondary unofficial PAYDAY2 port/HUD icon, not a named original PHG menu capture. Community label is proven only in the pinned localization file; README credits multiple games without per-mask provenance. Reference PNG is RGB256x257 screenshot from native256x256 DDS visualization; no source image conversion or editing was performed in this inventory. Source is grayscale; original game palette, UV, exact physical material, profile/back and hidden geometry are unknown. Dreadlocks are visible around/behind the mask; they are wearer elements to exclude from B, not mask appendages. Fine lines at256px do not establish certified high-resolution franchise details.

notes: Horseshoe/U crown, two dark round optics, small slotted nose, lower filter cluster and short curved breathing pieces retain the reference macro design.
External pale dreadlocks, wearer and black backdrop removed; grayscale material and neutral lighting retained.
Filter-hole and fine wear details are not certified exact at the source resolution.

Source is grayscale; original game palette, UV, exact physical material, profile/back and hidden geometry are unknown.
Dreadlocks are visible around/behind the mask; they are wearer elements to exclude from B, not mask appendages.
Fine lines at256px do not establish certified high-resolution franchise details.
